name: positive control: a pressure stated without its organ
condition: a world in which the resource an organism consumes per step is drawn from a pool that shrinks each generation
capability_rewarded: doing the same work with less of the resource
vacuity_condition: the pool never becomes binding within the horizon
cheat_control: an organism given the pool schedule in advance
negative_control: a world with a constant pool: the capability confers no advantage
